research_question: Does the way intraday information arrives—gradually through a continuous path versus discretely through a leverage shock—predict post-confirmation continuation or reclaim after realistic screening costs?

scenario.context: a statistically abnormal one-hour futures move normalized by prior-only bipower continuous volatility

state_router.GRADUAL_INFORMATION_DIFFUSION: the move is distributed across many aligned bars, no single bar dominates, spot/index/peer paths agree, base OI builds and futures aggressor flow persists; interpret as gradual information underreaction
state_router.DISCRETE_LEVERAGE_SHOCK: one bar dominates the move, spot/index delivery is weak, the perpetual leads and base OI contracts; interpret as a leverage/liquidity shock rather than gradual information
state_router.UNRESOLVED: mixed path shapes or contradictory state evidence are no-trade

independent_confirmation.GRADUAL_INFORMATION_DIFFUSION: the next completed five-minute bar extends with stable OI, aligned futures flow, spot/index follow and peer breadth; trade continuation after that close
independent_confirmation.DISCRETE_LEVERAGE_SHOCK: the next completed bar fails, OI contraction stops, futures flow flips and spot does not follow; trade reclaim after that close

scenario.exit: fixed two-hour gradual continuation or one-hour discrete reclaim horizon
scenario.causal_episode: overlapping one-hour paths on the same symbol are suppressed for two hours; one global position is selected across the four markets

data.spot_source: Binance Vision monthly and latest daily spot 5m klines
data.futures_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily futures 5m klines and indexPriceKlines
data.state_source: Binance Vision USD-M daily 5m metrics using base sum_open_interest
data.visibility: path and state use completed event bars; trade confirmation is the separately completed next bar

evaluation.same_event_arbitration: largest fixed path-context-times-state-quality score, then symbol
evaluation.overlap_policy: no selected episode while the active fixed route horizon is open

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day after global arbitration

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed family passing development, year-long stability, July confirmation and the August pulse advances to frozen NautilusTrader implementation.
decision_contract.reject: Do not adjust path-shape or state thresholds after evaluation. Preserve only a route positive across every declared split and move to another independent mechanism.
